subject: Request: temporary signup boost for SignalWorks POC (large context & high TPM)
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@signalworks.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC scope update — larger context windows & expected TPM spike

Hi Ben / Lauren,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding. Quick update from our side: the initial POC will include a retrieval-augmented generation flow that pushes context windows to ~80k tokens intermittently and peaks at ~4k TPM during our throughput tests.

Given that profile, the default signup allocation (10k tokens / 72 hours) won't be sufficient to run a meaningful evaluation. Can we get a temporary boost to the initial credits or a modified TTL so we can finish the evaluation without hitting hard limits? Ideally something in the range of 1.2M tokens over a 14-day window so we can run end-to-end benchmarks.

Attached is a short spec of the POC and the query distribution. Happy to jump on a call if that helps.

Best,
Maya
Maya Patel
Head of ML Engineering, SignalWorks
[Attachment: signalworks_poc_spec.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@signalworks.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC scope update — larger context windows & expected TPM spike

Maya — thanks for the details and the spec. We're excited to see SignalWorks run at scale.

Quick internal ask: can Priyom and Lauren confirm whether we can escalate the signup grant for this POC and what constraints we should set (TTL, per-minute quotas, fallback models)? The customer is explicitly testing LongerContext-2.1 (quantized variant) and will need sustained TPM bursts up to ~4k.

If we can do a self-serve credit top-up on the account that remains reversible, that would be ideal so they don't have to go through procurement.

Action items (from my side): once approved I'll send the grant details and a short runbook for monitoring.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Growth Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC scope update — larger context windows & expected TPM spike

Ben / Lauren — reviewed the spec. Approve temporary signup boost with guardrails. Recommendation: 1.2M token allowance for 14 days, max burst throttle at 5k TPM and soft per-minute rate limit of 600 rps (to prevent noisy tests from taking down shared pools). 2) Use quantized LongerContext-2.1 fallback at lower priority. 3) Mark grant as reversible and require CS confirmation before extending beyond 14 days.

I'll create the internal grant CSV and add the allocation to the account. Attaching the CSV I will upload to the billing ops bucket and tag the HubSpot deal with the grant id.

[Attachment: redwood_credit_grant.csv (csv)]

—Priyom
Sr. Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@signalworks.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC scope update — larger context windows & expected TPM spike

Thanks — that plan looks good. A few operational notes for Maya (cc'd): 1) We'll provision the 1.2M token grant scoped to the SignalWorks account id and set an automatic expiry 14 days from issuance. 2) We'll enable conservative KV-prefix caching for their eval routes to reduce token consumption of repeated context. 3) We'll instrument a budget alert to both the SignalWorks account and our CS channel once they hit 60% and 90%.

Maya — please confirm the account id you're using for the POC or let us know if you want us to provision a sandbox account. Also please confirm whether you need the grant to start immediately or at a scheduled time (e.g., after you've loaded your retrieval index).

—Lauren
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@signalworks.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC scope update — larger context windows & expected TPM spike

Maya — good news: we've issued the temporary signup boost. Details below and attached runbook/link.

Grant summary:
- Amount: 1,200,000 tokens
- Window: 14 days (starts now; expires 2027-08-05T16:45:00-07:00)
- Rate limits: burst clamp 5k TPM / soft 600 rps
- Models: LongerContext-2.1 (quantized) preferred; automatic fallback to gen-lite if needed
- Reversible: yes (contact Priyom to revoke)

Attachments and links:
- signalworks_poc_spec.pdf (their spec)
- redwood_credit_grant.csv (internal grant record)
- Runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOCSpecs
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/SignalWorks (deal SW-2027-019)

Let us know when you kick off the load-generation tests and we'll keep the CS alerting on so we can respond quickly to any anomalous token burn. Good luck — excited to see the results.

Best,
